items.name: R2 scope, process route, CP4 gate and aggregate design inputs are ready
items.notes: R2 repairs F03 only; R1 result remains immutable and this result supersedes it.

items.name: Only two matching validated published payloads with PASS/PASS can produce aggregate PASS
items.notes: The 4x4 table remains complete; raw/unpublished, missing, invalid, non-terminal and non-PASS inputs cannot reach aggregate PASS or projection.

items.name: Aggregate accepts exactly two PublishedLegResultHandle inputs and rejects raw or unpublished payloads
items.notes: AggregateRequest carries source/artifact published handles; no raw payload, unpublished outcome, directory scan or latest-result inference is accepted.

items.name: Validator rereads each payload and checks receipt, ref, digest, key and correlation before compute
items.notes: Result_ref is the read source; payload digest, receipt digest, writer receipt fields, derived single-write key and five-key correlation must all match.

items.name: The exact no-self-reference published-result and aggregate DAG is frozen
items.notes: LegResultPayload -> LegResultWriteReceipt -> validated PublishedLegResultHandle -> immutable AggregateResult -> AggregateWriteReceipt -> controlled projection, with no edge pointing back to a payload.

items.name: Immutable AggregateResult digest is fixed before write and its receipt remains external
items.notes: Aggregate payload excludes its own aggregate_ref, append/write receipt, receipt_digest, writer_id, written_at and projection receipt; external receipt is never written back.

items.name: Controlled projection starts only from a reread-valid aggregate receipt and never invokes Git or worktree
items.notes: Non-PASS/stale/persist-failed inputs hold with writer calls zero; aggregate has no Git/worktree/manual-sync import or runtime call.

items.name: Deterministic aggregate identity, immutable append and current-selector CAS prevent overwrite
items.notes: Same validated inputs are idempotent; conflicting digest/current selector is BLOCKED; last-write-wins and payload overwrite are forbidden.

items.name: ST-AW-003 producer and ST-AW-004 consumer use the same payload, receipt and handle protocol
items.notes: Producer returns external receipt/handle; consumer rereads and validates it; neither side owns or imports the other's executor/persistence implementation.

items.name: Raw/unpublished, tamper, no-self-reference and exact-DAG paths have deterministic tests
items.notes: TP-AW04-017..020 cover input kind, handle/receipt/ref tamper, aggregate forbidden fields and the exact evidence/projection sequence.
